scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:css
scripts.build:styles: sass --load-path=node_modules theme_components/sass/global-styles.scss:assets/css/global-styles.min.css theme_components/sass/critical-styles.scss:_includes/critical.min.css theme_components/sass/prism-styles.scss:assets/css/prism.min.css --style=compressed --no-error-css --charset && postcss assets/css/global-styles.min.css assets/css/prism.min.css _includes/critical.min.css --replace && node script/rewrite-critical-urls.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:images && pnpm run build:styles && pnpm run build:scripts && node script/hash-assets.mjs && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.dev: node script/hash-assets.mjs --dev && pnpm run build:styles && pnpm run build:scripts && (trap 'kill 0' INT; pnpm run watch:styles & pnpm run watch:scripts & bundle exec jekyll serve --config _config.yml,_config.dev.yml --livereload --port 4005 --host 0.0.0.0; wait)
